body:
Dance With the Devil
I have never tried any research chemicals before this event (save the 2c-x). I had a cocaine addiction,  which I went to treatment for, and have been nearly completely clean for over two years.
Hardly drink, rarely smoke weed. Regularly go to gym. As a teenager/early adult I did dabble in the rave scene for a couple years. This included the following substances:marijuana,  mushrooms, acid,  MDMA,  MDA,  2C-I, LSA (hbw), ketamine... And a lot of blow.
I received the order for my research chems. I ordered ~20 substances which cost just over a thousand dollars. I was most excited for ethylphenidate, due to hearing that it is a cocaine replacement -  bad move.
I tried 20mg to start. No allergic reaction, light threshold effects.
So I did another 80mg in two lines.  Whoa! There it is! Euphoria,  stimulation. For the next 72 hours I compulsively redosed,  didn't sleep,  eat or drink.
For the next 72 hours I compulsively redosed,  didn't sleep,  eat or drink.
I ended up missing two days of work and had to take etizolam to get to sleep on day three. I have a extremely high degree of responsibility in my current career. I have not missed a day at work for over two years. It was very disappointing to compulsively redose.
It's strong stuff,  it feels good...  Just stay very far away if you have past stimulant addiction.
[Reported total dose: 2 grams]
